title: The reverse-engineer skill missed the batch job's tables
scenario: The pod planned an EAP 8 schema migration from a spec the team's reverse-engineer skill wrote. Month-end rehearsal failed with ORA-00942 in reporting-batch, a module the spec says never touches the database. A draft postmortem blames model hallucination and asks for a bigger model.
task: Prove from the transcript, the repo and the tool what the model actually saw
Rule the context-window and hallucination theories in or out
Fix the scanner so partial output can never look complete; keep it context-friendly
Fix the skill so absence claims need proof; write the failure-mode log entry
acceptance: Complete summary of all tables and modules; paged output that announces truncation; working offsets
Default output names every table within a context budget
ANSWER.md names the silent truncation with evidence
